channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLhealthAndWellness, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Earlier Genetic Testing Linked to Higher Bilateral Mastectomy Rates in Young BRCA Carriers
item.description: Over two decades, bilateral mastectomy use rose among BRCA carriers aged 40 or younger with early breast cancer, while breast-conserving surgery declined.

item.title: Uterine-Sparing Mesh Repair Shows Better Outcomes Than Hysterectomy for Prolapse
item.description: Vaginal mesh hysteropexy led to fewer composite treatment failures than vaginal hysterectomy with uterosacral suspension over 10 years of follow-up.

item.title: In-Hospital Mortality Low for Elective Catheter Ablation in Atrial Fibrillation
item.description: The in-hospital mortality rate for elective catheter ablation in atrial fibrillation patients was low at about 0.029%, according to recent evidence.

item.title: Daraxonrasib Shows Antitumor Activity in Pretreated RAS-Mutant NSCLC
item.description: In previously treated advanced RAS-mutant non-small-cell lung cancer, daraxonrasib produced objective responses in about one-third of patients.
